itens.titulo: 3M Board Approves New $6 Billion Share Repurchase Authorization, Declares Quarterly Dividend
itens.descricao: 3M Board Approves New $6 Billion Share Repurchase Authorization, Declares Quarterly Dividend PR Newswire
itens.texto:
SAINT PAUL, Minn., Nov. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The 3M Board of Directors (NYSE: MMM) today authorized the repurchase of up to $6.0 billion of 3M's outstanding common stock, in addition to the remaining $1.5 billion available under the company's existing 2025 repurchase authorization, resulting in a total of $7.5 billion available under the company's repurchase program. The authorization has no pre-established closing date.
The board also declared a dividend on the company's common stock of $0.78 per share for the fourth quarter of 2026. The dividend is payable Dec. 11, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on Nov. 13, 2026.
3M has paid dividends to its shareholders without interruption for more than 100 years.
About 3M
3M (NYSE: MMM) is focused on transforming industries around the world by applying science and creating innovative, customer-focused solutions. Our multi-disciplinary team is working to solve tough customer problems by leveraging diverse technology platforms, differentiated capabilities, global footprint, and operational excellence. Discover how 3M is shaping the future at 3M.com/news.

itens.titulo: Advanced Micro (AMD) Reports Q3 Earnings: What Key Metrics Have to Say
itens.descricao: Advanced Micro (AMD) Reports Q3 Earnings: What Key Metrics Have to Say Yahoo Finance
trechos: For the quarter ended September 2026, Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) reported revenue of $13.38 billion, up 44.7% over the same period last year.
EPS came in at $2.09, compared to $1.20 in the year-ago quarter.
The reported revenue compares to the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $13.13 billion, representing a surprise of +1.89%.
The company delivered an EPS surprise of +7.73%, with the consensus EPS estimate being $1.94.

Here is how Advanced Micro performed in the just reported quarter in terms of the metrics most widely monitored and projected by Wall Street analysts: - Net Revenue- Data Center: $8.55 billion versus the seven-analyst average estimate of $8.27 billion.
The reported number represents a year-over-year change of +96.9%.
- Net Revenue- Total Client and Gaming: $3.72 billion versus the seven-analyst average estimate of $3.69 billion.
- Net Revenue- Embedded: $1.11 billion compared to the $1.07 billion average estimate based on seven analysts.

trechos: That sent Intel's stock down 29% on Friday, its worst day since the 1970s.
Caught in the fallout of Intel and the broader tech sector, AMD fell 10.9% that day and slid another 7.5% Monday.

It rose 18.6% after Q1 2026 results, when it guided about 6.5% above expectations.

AMD's 30-day implied volatility is elevated going into earnings, closing Monday higher than on about 81% of days over the past year.
To capture that premium while limiting time beyond the earnings announcement, the trade uses the November 4 weeklies.

trechos: As urnas já deram seu recado, mas a Bolsa ainda tem muita história para contar em 2026.
Em outubro, o Ibovespa caiu 9,88%, segundo levantamento da Genial, enquanto a carteira Ibovespa 5+ da casa recuou 7,46%.
Na Genial, as commodities assumiram a liderança da carteira Top Ações, com 31% de participação, seguidas pelo setor financeiro (25%) e por elétricas e saneamento (21%).
Bens industriais representam outros 13%, enquanto construção e shoppings, assim como varejo, respondem por 5% cada.
A exposição a commodities saltou de 15% para 31%, com a entrada de Suzano (SUZB3), Vale (VALE3), Prio (PRIO3), MBRF (MBRF3) e SLC Agrícola (SLCE3).
Petrobras (PETR4) e CSN (CSNA3), por outro lado, deixaram a seleção.
No Andbank, cinco das dez posições da Carteira Meta estão ligadas a energia elétrica e saneamento: Axia (AXIA3), Copel (CPLE3), CPFL Energia (CPFE3), Sabesp (SBSP3) e outras companhias do segmento.
Já o BB Investimentos reforçou sua exposição ao setor de seguros, com a entrada de Caixa Seguridade (CXSE3).

itens.titulo: Nvidia’s Dismal Run Might Be Coming to an End. Grab NVDA Stock While It’s Still Around $200.
itens.descricao: Nvidia’s Dismal Run Might Be Coming to an End. Grab NVDA Stock While It’s Still Around $200. Yahoo Finance
trechos: The chip-designing giant hit its record highs last month and has since lost 15% from those levels.
As of last week's closing prices, the stock's year-to-date returns trail both the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 Index ($IUXX) and the diversified S&P 500 Index ($SPX).
For instance, its revenues more than doubled in the most recent reported quarter, and its guidance for fiscal Q3 implies they will nearly double again.
For the next fiscal year, Nvidia guided a 70% revenue growth, which is astonishing considering the high base.

Following Nvidia's fiscal Q2 earnings release in August, I noted that despite the strong growth and reasonable valuations, Nvidia wasn't a "buy." With NVDA coming off those levels, let's explore the stock's outlook.
Incidentally, all the Magnificent 7 names, which happen to be Nvidia's biggest customer set, plunged following their September quarter earnings, in part due to growing anxiety over their AI capex.
To make things worse, Intel's (INTC) tepid Q4 guidance led to a sell-off in other chip stocks, which also put pressure on NVDA.
